 'Avengers Endgame: Encore' comes to Disney+ ahead of 'Doomsday' release 
 1:35 ‘Avengers: Endgame’ back in theaters Disney+ By Yi-Jin Yu November 13, 2026, 11:47 AM 
 Marvel fans can stream "Avengers Endgame: Encore" ahead of next month's release of the highly anticipated " Avengers: Doomsday. "
 "Avengers Endgame: Encore," the sequel to " Avengers: Infinity War ," is available to stream on Disney+. A re-release of 2019's "Avengers: Endgame," it features four new scenes that link directly to "Doomsday."
 The re-release will be included in the streaming service's "Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday" collection, a curated roundup of past Marvel series and films intended to prepare viewers for the upcoming movie.
 "Avengers: Doomsday" will be released in theaters Friday, Dec. 18.
 Marvel Studios’ “Avengers Endgame: Encore,” the conclusion to the Infinity Saga, will debut Nov.13, 2026 exclusively on Disney+. Disney+ " Avengers Endgame: Encore " stars Robert Downey Jr. as Iron Man/Tony Stark, Chris Evans as Captain America/Steve Rogers, and Mark Ruffalo as the Hulk/Bruce Banner and chronicles the remaining Avengers' struggles to restore global order as they face off against Titan warlord Thanos, played by Josh Brolin.
 Related Marvel TV series 'Zodiac' sets 2028 Disney+ release "Avengers Endgame: Encore" was also released in theaters back in September. Some theatrical screenings of the film included the four new scenes.
 Related New teaser-trailer released for 'Avengers: Doomsday' An official synopsis for "Doomsday" hints at a reunion of "beloved heroes from three distinct universes" who "will be set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered."
